question: Where is the nearest restaurant while traveling toward South University, Austin, Round Rock, TX from Sherwood Forest Faire, McDade, TX?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_state, p.addr_city FROM pois AS p WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine(start_loc.geometry, end_loc.geometry), 5000)::geography FROM (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sherwood Forest Faire%' LIMIT 1) AS start_loc, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%South University%' AND (addr_city ILIKE '%Austin%' OR addr_city ILIKE '%Round Rock%') LIMIT 1) AS end_loc )) ORDER BY ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Sherwood Forest Faire%' LIMIT 1)::geography) LIMIT 1;
